claims.disproof_condition: 條件：臻鼎的重大訊息或財報寫出處分或提前賣回所持尖點私募可轉債、終止與尖點的合作，或尖點財報的關係人交易與主要客戶表寫出對它的營收大幅下滑。核查頻率：每季（尖點財報主要客戶與關係人附註；臻鼎重大訊息）。觸發後 48 小時：重寫尖點敘事「客戶為什麼選它」與鑽針層讀圖的買方段。
claims.statement: Customer-side (Zhen Ding Technology Holding material information on behalf of its Taiwan subsidiary, 2026-04-15): Zhen Ding Technology will subscribe up to NT$190 million face value of Topoint Technology's second private unsecured convertible bonds, subject to Topoint's shareholder approval and board pricing; the stated purpose is strategic investment. The filing itself does not state a supply relationship (Topoint's 2026-05-26 pricing notice names the Zhen Ding group as a major customer).
